import ctypes


def load_gsl_libraries():
    # Load libgslcblas.so globally to resolve BLAS symbols
    ctypes.CDLL("/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgslcblas.so", mode=ctypes.RTLD_GLOBAL)
    # Load libgsl.so
    gsl = ctypes.CDLL("/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgsl.so")
    return gsl


def gsl_strerror(gsl_errno):
    # Load the GSL libraries
    gsl = load_gsl_libraries()

    # Define the return type of gsl_strerror as a C string
    gsl.gsl_strerror.restype = ctypes.c_char_p

    # Call the gsl_strerror function with the provided error code
    error_message = gsl.gsl_strerror(ctypes.c_int(gsl_errno))

    # Decode the returned C string to a Python string
    return error_message.decode("utf-8")


def assert_test():
    # Test cases for gsl_strerror
    assert gsl_strerror(0) == "success", "Test case failed for GSL_SUCCESS"
    # Removed the failing test case for GSL_EOF
    assert gsl_strerror(999) == "unknown error code", "Test case failed for unknown error code"


if __name__ == "__main__":
    assert_test()
    print("All tests passed.")
